documents.title: Lincoln County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 98 pages. Amounts are the Ordinance Section 5 'Maximum appropriated amounts' (pp. 2-6). General Fund office categories: 'Amount Request' column of each Application for Appropriation (pp. 8-59). column.
